title: Gladiator's Quest
description: A mod that adds a mysterious amulet that gives bonuses when used and... unexpected punishment?
body:
This mod adds a new item to the traveling merchant's purview: the gladiator's medallion. Using it grants you several buffs that will help you in the game. However, everything comes at a price… I advise you not to spoil the mod's content for yourself and to play Minecraft with it.
![the cost of the amulet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e15bc79979514145fc6ebdab30a401bab276002.png)

# !!!Attention!!!
The mod is kind of a joke, so don't take it too seriously.
I only make the mod in my free time, so updates can take a long time to come out.
The game version may change in the future, I haven't decided yet.
And most importantly: DO NOT USE THE AMULET IN HARDCORE!!!
